messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: connectBluetooth
function.description: Establishes a connection to a Bluetooth device using its name. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

device_name.description: The name of the Bluetooth device to connect to.

timeout.description: The number of seconds to attempt a connection before timing out.

auto_reconnect.description: Whether to automatically attempt to reconnect if the connection is lost.

message.content:
Here’s a quick‑look list of the long weekends that occurred in Canada during 2023.  (A “long weekend” is defined as a statutory holiday that falls on a Friday or Monday, giving you a three‑day break that includes the weekend.)

| Date(s) | Holiday | Notes |
|---------|---------|-------|
| **Jan 1 – 3** | New Year’s Day (observed on Monday Jan 2) | New Year’s Day fell on Sunday, so the holiday was observed on Monday. |
| **Feb 20 – 22** | Family Day (in Alberta, British Columbia, Saskatchewan, Ontario, New Brunswick, Manitoba, and Prince Edward Island) | Family Day is a statutory holiday in those provinces. |
| **Apr 7 – 9** | Good Friday | Good Friday is a statutory holiday in all provinces. |
| **May 22 – 24** | Victoria Day | Victoria Day is a statutory holiday in all provinces. |
| **Jul 1 – 3** | Canada Day (observed on Monday Jul 3) | Canada Day fell on Saturday, so the holiday was observed on Monday. |
| **Sep 4 – 6** | Labour Day | Labour Day is a statutory holiday in all provinces. |
| **Oct 9 – 11** | Thanksgiving | Thanksgiving is a statutory holiday in all provinces. |
| **Nov 11 – 13** | Remembrance Day (observed on Monday Nov 13) | Remembrance Day is a statutory holiday in all provinces. |
| **Dec 25 – 27** | Christmas (observed on Monday Dec 27) | Christmas fell on Monday, so the holiday was observed on Monday. |

> **Note:**  
> • Some provinces have additional statutory holidays that may create extra long weekends (e.g., St. Patrick’s Day in Newfoundland & Labrador, St. John’s Day in Prince Edward Island, etc.).  
> • The table above lists the *national* statutory holidays that create long weekends across the country.  

Feel free to plug these dates into your holiday‑planning app!
